articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring substantially improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a unified architecture that collapses previously separate models into one system. Benchmarks show significant gains on ARC-AGI-2 and GPQA, narrowing the gap on tasks previously considered out of reach for autoregressive language models.

articles.title: Google DeepMind Introduces Gemini Ultra 2 with Million-Token Persistent Context
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, extending reliable context handling to over 2 million tokens with a new persistent memory layer that allows the model to maintain coherent state across sessions. The architecture introduces a hierarchical attention mechanism that dramatically reduces inference cost at long contexts, making enterprise-scale document analysis practical in production.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Deploys Humanoid Workers at BMW South Carolina Plant
articles.summary: Figure AI expanded its commercial humanoid deployment, with its Figure 03 robots now performing multi-step assembly and material handling tasks alongside human workers at BMW's Spartanburg facility. The robots leverage on-device vision-language models for real-time task adaptation, marking one of the largest sustained humanoid deployments in automotive manufacturing.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Demonstrates Autonomous Disaster Response in DARPA Field Trials
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics' electric Atlas robot completed a series of DARPA-organized disaster response scenarios, autonomously navigating collapsed structures, operating valves, and carrying 40 kg payloads over rubble without remote operator intervention. The system uses a new proprioceptive-visual foundation model trained on simulation and real-world data, dramatically improving robustness to novel terrain.

articles.title: Anthropic Publishes Mechanistic Interpretability Breakthrough: Full-Circuit Tracing in Claude
articles.summary: Anthropic released a landmark paper demonstrating end-to-end circuit-level interpretability for its Claude model family, showing how specific factual claims and reasoning chains can be traced to identifiable computational subgraphs. The work provides the first scalable methodology for auditing model outputs against internal representations, with immediate implications for AI safety assurance and regulatory compliance.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node at Arizona Fab
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its Arizona Fab 2 has entered volume production on the N1.4 gate-all-around transistor process, the most advanced node manufactured on US soil. Early yields are reportedly within 5% of Taiwan facilities, a milestone for US semiconductor supply chain resilience and a key enabler for next-generation AI accelerator chips.

articles.title: Meta Releases Open-Source Llama 4 Behemoth with MoE Architecture at 1.2T Active Parameters
articles.summary: Meta publicly released the weights and training methodology for Llama 4 Behemoth, a mixture-of-experts model with 1.2 trillion active parameters that matches or exceeds proprietary frontier models on major benchmarks. The open-weight release includes fine-tuning recipes optimized for 8-GPU clusters, significantly lowering the barrier for enterprise and research adoption of frontier-class models.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Achieves 600 Wh/kg in Production Cells
articles.summary: QuantumScape reported that its latest solid-state lithium-metal cells have reached 600 Wh/kg at the production-cell level, nearly doubling the energy density of conventional lithium-ion batteries. The cells completed 1,000 fast-charge cycles with under 10% capacity degradation, a result that could transform EV range, robotics endurance, and portable electronics within two years of automotive qualification.
